notes.title: OPEN WORLD SURVIVAL BUILDING FESTIVAL
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45000082/d7ff7b027c5f3afcdb18bde6dcf0c9c32e429f9a.png[/img]





[h1]IMPOSSIBLE ISLAND[/h1]

If you want to play a pirate-themed survival game, this is the game for you.
It's in early access and is still being updated.
It offers more content as we get closer to the full version.

[h2]CONTENT WE PLAN TO MAKE WITH THE FULL VERSION[/h2]

Islands you can explore on the sea by raft.
Battle with big ships and sea creatures.
Different enemies in different biomes and deep dungeons to explore.

[h2]TECHNICAL IMPROVEMENTS[/h2]

FIXES RELATED TO FPS ISSUES.
ARTIFICIAL INTELLIGENCE IMPROVEMENTS.
EXPANSION OF THE ITEMS WE USE FOR BUILDING AND CRAFTING.
DIFFERENT TYPES OF MINES.
MORE WEAPONS.
MORE INTERACTIVE DOMESTICATED ANIMALS.

notes.title: Early Access V0.21 Update
notes.content:
[h1]Updated content [/h1]
- 3 new enemy units
  - Pig
  - Deer 
  - Wolf

- Visual updates have been made.
- Added volcanic area.
- Changes were made to the quality of trees and grass.
- Language improvements and enhancements.
- Fixed the bug related to the bed.

notes.title: Playtest period is over
notes.content:
[h1]What improvements we made during the playtest process.[/h1]

[h3][list]
[*] Landscaping and visual quality improvements.
[*] Npc improvements
[*] Improvements of NPCs in the dungeon.
[*] Tree and grass quality has been fixed.
[*] We fixed the structures that you can pass through at some points.
[*] Fixed and updated difficult to understand missions in the mission system.
[*] Sound levels and rain sounds have been fixed.
[*] Updated the chests placed at some points in the level.
[*] Achievements added.
[*] The sea level was rising above the land at some points, this bug was fixed.
[*] Fixed the light emitted by torches and campfires.
[*] Fixed some bugs in swimming and breathing mechanics.
[/list][/h3]

[previewyoutube=z3EG3ovMG6U;full][/previewyoutube]




We will launch with early access and we are waiting for you, our valuable players, to our community server.
